claim_limit: Both are exploratory visualizations of saved OpenFOAM alpha.water fields. Neither validates the model, reproduction, or physical velocity/breakup behavior.

rouaix-long-attempt-10x.mp4.solver: interIsoFoam, OpenFOAM v2512; 16 MPI ranks; 2,733,120-cell mesh
rouaix-long-attempt-10x.mp4.alpha_observer: Computed cell-centered alpha.water; left panel uses the nearest-to-z=0 cell layer at each y, right panel uses maximum cell alpha over span z. Full color scale 0–1; orange contour alpha=0.1, black contour alpha=0.9.
rouaix-long-attempt-10x.mp4.spatial_and_temporal_display: No smoothing or temporal interpolation. Matplotlib contours interpolate native cell-center samples for display; each saved snapshot is held without generating intermediate flow fields.
rouaix-long-attempt-10x.mp4.orientation: Native y coordinate retained; y=0 roof/source at top, y=-10 m at bottom; gravity is -y and points down on screen.
rouaix-long-attempt-10x.mp4.run_context: Continuation reaches t=1.500019 s, before the paper-described approximately 5 s stabilization horizon. Labeled NOT VALIDATED; not presented as a credible reproduction.

rouaix-startup-diagnostic-10x.mp4.solver: interIsoFoam, OpenFOAM v2512; 20 MPI ranks; 2,733,120-cell mesh; gradient-limited C diagnostic branch
rouaix-startup-diagnostic-10x.mp4.alpha_observer: Computed alpha.water=0.5 isosurface, interpolated from cell to point data, linear contour, then triangulated.
rouaix-startup-diagnostic-10x.mp4.smoothing: Display geometry only: two Taubin windowed-sinc iterations, pass band 0.1; does not modify alpha.water or water inventory.
rouaix-startup-diagnostic-10x.mp4.orientation: Screen-up is world +y; gravity -y points down.

playback.sampling: hold each saved snapshot; no temporal interpolation or extrapolation

rouaix-startup-diagnostic-10x.mp4.run_context: Fresh-start water diagnostic, not a paper reproduction. Run stopped at t=0.17425 s when max |U|=1025.043 m/s exceeded the predeclared 1000 m/s operational runaway stop. Video ends at last saved field t=0.15 s; no clipping or velocity cap.

reproduction_note: Raw CFD fields, reconstruction bundles and intermediate render outputs are preserved locally under ignored results/runs paths; the published preview bundle does not contain the full source fields.
